stories.title: The best gifts for nine-year-olds, picked by nine-year-olds and parents
stories.summary: The Guardian’s gift guide draws on choices from nine-year-olds and parents for children entering the early tween years. Its recommendations include popcorn makers, Lego Fortnite products and a popular water bottle, aiming to suit growing curiosity and independence.

links.headline: The best gifts for nine-year-olds, picked by nine-year-olds and parents
links.excerpt: Popcorn makers, Lego Fortnite and the coolest water bottle around … surprise the mini tween in your life with our pick of the top gifts and toys • The best gifts for eight-year-olds The start of the tween years, nine years old, is a sweet spot between curiosity and growing independence, making it a fun, though sometimes tricky, age to buy for.</p

stories.title: How tech became the villain of the US midterms
stories.summary: Datacentres, artificial intelligence and hostility toward the billionaires developing them have made big technology a target in the US midterm campaign. One campaign ad illustrates the backlash by showing an idyllic stream turning brown as two concrete datacentres appear on its banks.

links.headline: How tech became the villain of the US midterms
links.excerpt: Datacenters, AI and distaste for the billionaires developing it has soured Americans on big tech How will Trump’s mass deportation agenda shape the US midterm elections?
